nodes.label: Forge and Steel Design System
nodes.rationale: Two reactions, nothing else matters: 'this wasn't made by AI,' and 'someone put real effort into this.' One accent. Sentence case headlines. Real content in every state. Values here are the source of truth; app/globals.css implements them as CSS variables mapped onto the existing shadcn token contract.

nodes.label: Forge and Steel Color System (primitives + semantic mapping)
nodes.rationale: One accent rule: if a state needs a non-molten color, it uses destructive (error), never a second orange. --ember-strong is not a second accent, same hue, darker step, chosen only for text legibility (orange-600 text fails the 4.5:1 AA ratio at small sizes; orange-700 clears it at 5.6:1+).
nodes.norm_label: forge and steel color system (primitives + semantic mapping)

nodes.label: Forge and Steel Typography System (three families)
nodes.rationale: Three families, three roles, never crossed: Bricolage Grotesque (headlines only), Inter (body/UI text), JetBrains Mono (eyebrows, micro labels, nav, code). Headlines are sentence case, never all-caps; only eyebrows/labels/button labels/status bar may be uppercase.
nodes.norm_label: forge and steel typography system (three families)

nodes.label: Radius System, the 9px Signature
nodes.rationale: Nested corners run 2-4px tighter than their parent so corners stay concentric (e.g. a radius-panel card holding a radius-forge button).

nodes.label: Elevation System (two shadows + static glow)
nodes.rationale: Exactly two shadows, plus one static glow. Nothing else does hierarchy work.

nodes.label: Motion Rules (transform/opacity only)
nodes.rationale: Transform and opacity only. Never animate top, left, width, height, or box-shadow. No filter: blur(), animated or static. prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses the landing scroll-reveal to a plain opacity fade, no rotation, no offset.

nodes.label: Copy Rules (one CTA verb, no AI phrasing)
nodes.rationale: One CTA verb: FORGE. Never STRIKE, never GENERATE as a UI action label. No pricing anywhere. No em-dashes. No AI-sounding phrasing.
nodes.norm_label: copy rules (one cta verb, no ai phrasing)

nodes.label: Upload Security Hardening Measures
nodes.rationale: The upload is never written to disk and never served back to a browser; validated, decoded, re-encoded, base64-encoded, and sent to the model. Rejections return a short, non-leaky message; the server logs a reason code, not raw image bytes.

nodes.label: Playwright Test Suite Description
nodes.rationale: Tests run serially, the in-memory rate limiter and the live GPT-4o calls are shared server-side state.

nodes.label: Tailwind Play CDN (runtime compilation in preview)
nodes.norm_label: tailwind play cdn (runtime compilation in preview)

nodes.label: Rationale: Why GitHub Models instead of OpenAI directly?
nodes.rationale: GitHub Models is a free, OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint giving access to GPT-4o-tier models without billing setup. The Vercel AI SDK works with it via createOpenAI({ baseURL }). GitHub Models supports Chat Completions but not the newer Responses API, so the provider is called via .chat() explicitly.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: why github models instead of openai directly?

nodes.label: Rationale: Why streaming?
nodes.rationale: Vision generation takes 20-30 seconds. Without streaming the UI freezes and feels broken. With streaming, the first token arrives within ~2 seconds and perceived latency drops by an order of magnitude.

nodes.label: Rationale: Why an iframe with Tailwind Play CDN for preview?
nodes.rationale: Generated HTML uses arbitrary Tailwind classes unknown at build time. Rendering inline would require runtime JIT in the parent app and risks style leakage. A sandboxed iframe with srcDoc solves both: loads Tailwind via CDN for runtime compilation, and sandbox='allow-scripts' (without allow-same-origin) isolates generated content from the host app.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: why an iframe with tailwind play cdn for preview?

nodes.label: Rationale: Why force the model to skip markdown code fences (and clean them anyway)?
nodes.rationale: GPT-4o ignores explicit 'no code fences' instructions a meaningful fraction of the time. The system prompt asks; a stripCodeFences regex cleans up when the model doesn't listen. Defense in depth, the same principle as validating input on both client and server.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: why force the model to skip markdown code fences (and clean them anyway)?

nodes.label: Rationale: Why one light theme, and a dark code panel inside it?
nodes.rationale: The rest of the app is paper and steel (see DESIGN.md for the full token system). The one deliberately dark surface is the code output panel, styled to look like a real editor rather than the page around it. That contrast carries the 'instrument' feel.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: why one light theme, and a dark code panel inside it?

nodes.label: Rationale: Why localStorage for history instead of a database?
nodes.rationale: History is a local aid to iteration. localStorage keeps it fast, private, and zero-infrastructure. Thumbnails are downscaled to a max of 200px on the long edge and stored as JPEG data URLs so they survive serialization across reloads; object URLs, which die with the page, are not used.
nodes.norm_label: rationale: why localstorage for history instead of a database?

nodes.label: PixelForge Roadmap
nodes.rationale: PixelForge is not 'done.' It does one thing — turn a screenshot into code — and the bar is to do that one thing better than anything else, then keep raising the bar. Nothing here should compromise the ember-on-graphite instrument identity and the clean generate → preview → copy loop. Each item answers: does this make the core thing better, or is it decoration? Decoration is rejected.

nodes.label: Ember-on-Graphite Instrument Identity (quality bar)
nodes.rationale: Identity is non-negotiable. Ember-on-graphite, hairline rules, mono labels, corner ticks. No glow blobs, no glass-morphism as a primary device, no second font, no indigo/purple accents, no emoji in UI copy, no marketing tone.

nodes.label: Clean Generate → Preview → Copy Loop (quality bar)
nodes.rationale: The core loop stays fast. No feature may slow or clutter upload → forge → preview → copy. New capability lives at the edges.
nodes.norm_label: clean generate → preview → copy loop (quality bar)

nodes.label: Quality Bar (applies to every roadmap item)
nodes.rationale: Dependencies are earned (each new package justified in its PR). Server changes are surgical (the streaming contract and fidelity-tuned system prompt are assets, touch only with intent). Accessibility and responsiveness are features, not afterthoughts, for both the UI and the generated code.
nodes.norm_label: quality bar (applies to every roadmap item)

nodes.label: Roadmap #1: Decouple framework toggle from Tabs context (shipped)
nodes.rationale: Shipped: the HTML/JSX toggle has its own nested Tabs root in Toolbar.tsx, separate from the Preview/Code Tabs root. Sharing one root meant clicking JSX silently blanked the Preview/Code panel, since Radix only renders content for the active tab's value and 'jsx' matched neither.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #1: decouple framework toggle from tabs context (shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #2: Persist history and preferences across reloads (partially shipped)
nodes.rationale: History shipped via useHistory.ts, keyed pixelforge:history:v1 in localStorage; simpler than a proposed IndexedDB approach since thumbnails are downscaled to JPEG data URLs up front. Framework and device-width preference still reset to defaults on every reload (not shipped).
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #2: persist history and preferences across reloads (partially shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #3: Syntax highlighting in the Code view (shipped)
nodes.rationale: Shiki, dynamically imported as a singleton in lib/highlight.ts, applied in CodePanel.tsx once status==='ready'; themed to github-dark with background overridden. Correction: not zero-runtime-JS, the highlighter/grammars are lazy-loaded on first use rather than bundled upfront.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #3: syntax highlighting in the code view (shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #4: Richer export menu (not shipped)
nodes.rationale: A small split-button: Copy code · Copy as full HTML doc · Download · Open in new tab. All client-side, no new deps. Effort S, Risk Low.

nodes.label: Roadmap #5: Cmd+H reconsideration + shortcut polish (not shipped)
nodes.rationale: Cmd+H collides with macOS 'Hide window.' Remap history to a non-colliding chord (e.g. Cmd+Y or Cmd+Shift+H). Effort S, Risk Low.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #5: cmd+h reconsideration + shortcut polish (not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #6: Multi-framework output — HTML, React, Vue (mid term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: JSX was the first step; the real value is 'give me this UI in my stack.' Highest-leverage expansion of the core. The server prompt already has a rider pattern — add riders per target. Effort M-L, Risk Medium (prompt quality per target must be validated).
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #6: multi-framework output — html, react, vue (mid term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #7: Refinement loop, 'nudge the output' (shipped)
nodes.rationale: A RefinementBar below the output, gated on status==='ready', re-calls /api/generate in a new refine mode with current code, instruction, and original screenshot (toggleable, default on). Each revision streams as a full document, never a diff, lands in history like a forge. Retry replays a failed refinement rather than falling back to a fresh forge.

nodes.label: Roadmap #8: Element-level inspection / partial regeneration (mid term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: Let the user draw a box on the source screenshot (or click a rendered region) and regenerate just that fragment. Hard but distinctive; a 'wow' feature if done well; defer until items 6 and 7 are solid. Effort L, Risk High.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #8: element-level inspection / partial regeneration (mid term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #9: Model choice + quality/speed toggle (mid term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: A small model selector (GPT-4o vs a stronger vision model as available). Surface a draft/refined toggle mapping to temperature + model, keeping GPT-4o the default. Effort S-M, Risk Low-Medium.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #9: model choice + quality/speed toggle (mid term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #10: Accessibility + responsiveness audit of generated output (mid term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: A differentiator is verifying the model's a11y claims: lightweight client-side pass (axe-core in the iframe) reporting issues, e.g. 'a11y: 9 landmarks, 2 missing alt.' Optionally feed findings back into a refinement. Effort M, Risk Medium.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #10: accessibility + responsiveness audit of generated output (mid term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #11: Accounts + cloud history + shareable links (long term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: 'Send someone a link to this generation' is a natural growth loop. Optional auth, server-side persistence, a public read-only share URL. First item that touches the backend meaningfully — scope carefully, keep the no-account path fully functional. Effort L, Risk High.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #11: accounts + cloud history + shareable links (long term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #12: Design-system-aware generation (long term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: Let a user upload or connect a component manifest (shadcn, MUI, their own) and have the model emit code using those components. Extremely valuable to real teams; extremely hard to do well. Effort XL, Risk High.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #12: design-system-aware generation (long term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #13: Figma / image-URL / live-URL ingestion (long term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: Additional source adapters feeding the same pipeline: Figma via its API, live URL via a server-side screenshot. Respect copyright and robots. Effort L per adapter, Risk Medium-High.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #13: figma / image-url / live-url ingestion (long term, not shipped)

nodes.label: Roadmap #14: Batch / sequence mode (long term, not shipped)
nodes.rationale: Upload several screenshots; generate a small multi-page/multi-component set with shared styling extracted across them. Effort XL, Risk High.
nodes.norm_label: roadmap #14: batch / sequence mode (long term, not shipped)
